scope: Three existing one-shot Phase88 programs, not Phase93 timing batches or full45. Native roles emit QBE; upstream emits C. Native/upstream request ratios describe different native-representation workflows, never same-format compiler throughput. Ready-executable costs compare normal cached-runtime QBE construction with full upstream C/Clang O2; no upstream PCH is claimed.
timingScope: Fresh process, startup+input reads+Base preparation+output writes+exit; common blocking os.wait4 timer; input authentication and receipts outside clock. Native cache/live explicit; upstream source Base in both.

buildPolicy.native: Pinned QBE amd64_sysv, GNU as -mbranches-within-32B-boundaries, gcc -no-pie objects -pthread -lm
buildPolicy.upstream: pinned Clang -isystem bundled include/clang -O2 emitted C -lm -pthread; no PCH

clocks.requestSeconds: Whole compiler child through complete output and exit, native QBE versus upstream C explicitly distinct formats.
clocks.machineBuildSeconds: Sum of fresh QBE/as/link children or fresh upstream Clang child.
clocks.readyExecutableStageSumSeconds: Request plus machine-build child sums; excludes Python authentication/reporting and generated-program execution.
clocks.readyExecutableHarnessSeconds: Elapsed through binary construction including between-stage Python bookkeeping, starting after preflight.
clocks.executionSeconds: Single full-output correctness observation only, not program-speed benchmark.

modeNotes.cache: Native authenticated prepared Base; upstream loads/checks source Base. Persistent-cache advantage disclosed.
modeNotes.live: Native and upstream source Base, fresh processes; OS caches are not flushed.
